registry_entry.intent: Field View: Ultipedia's play-design toolset — one shared scene model exposed as a coaching whiteboard, a keyframed play designer/animator, and a live-repainting strong/weak space heatmap implementing the client's validated space model. Client-only; adds /field-view and /field-view/designer to the existing SPA.

signals.message: feat/space-model recalibrated the vert/force-side preset data in scene/presets.ts (P1 module): mark now angles upfield-lateral, stack shortened to 2-yd spacing ending at gain 20, defense gains two sags, a break bracket, and a deep-centre last back. Cutter 1 stays at (50,20). Visual-only impact on whiteboard/designer; required for the brief §8.1 acceptance geometry.

feat/play-designer added an optional `disabled` prop to render/pieceLayer.tsx (pointer-events off, tabIndex -1, aria-disabled) so Designer can block edits while playing or scrubbed between keyframes. feat/heatmap-overlay owns render/ next — the prop is additive and defaults to false, but FieldCanvas/OverlayRail work must preserve it. Also: PlayEntity now lives in play/format.ts (scene/presetFormat.ts re-exports), and the Designer stage is role=group not role=img.

feat/scene-foundation.intent: Blocking scene foundation for Field View: scene types, field geometry, pure scene ops, subscribe-store with rAF coalescing, four presets, SVG field layer, and the two route shells.

feat/whiteboard.intent: Whiteboard mode 1 in full: piece visuals in render/tokens.ts (ADR-10), pointer drag with thrower-carries-mark, the preset system (registry + save/rename/delete/export/import over localStorage, ADR-9), PNG export, keyboard nudge.

feat/space-model.intent: Headless space model: brief §4 transcribed as a pure framework-free library (constants, math, five layer functions, computeGrid, explainCell, palette) plus every model-property acceptance check from brief §8 (1,2,3,4,6,7,8) and the FR-3.2 no-receiver-gate regression as executable tests. No UI.

feat/play-designer.intent: Mode 2: versioned PlayFile format, serialization behind PlayStore, import validation, linear tween, keyframe timeline UI, transport, metadata, JSON import/export

feat/heatmap-overlay.intent: Mode 3 UI: canvas heatmap painter, overlay rail (Space toggle, lens, layer toggles, legend), tuning panel, hover readout, localStorage prefs, ?perf=1 frame budget validation. Must not modify space/.

feat/acceptance-polish.intent: Client acceptance pass and cross-cutting polish: written §8 checklist, manual check run + deferred visuals/presets/UI review, tablet layout, sub-768 message, full a11y sweep, full-suite regression
